'''B'Thazoshe Bridge''' was a rock formation in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Standing at 90 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] high, it was the largest natural bridge on the planet, and was believed to be formed from ancient drainage channels.

It was a sacred site of the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]], and its name translated to ''bantha horn turned to stone'' in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]. They had a tradition of firing off rounds from a [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] before passing through as failure to do so would bring bad luck to the tribe. The bridge also marked the boundary of their ancient hunting territory. Coincidentally, in at least one case misfortune did ensue when one passerby failed to perform this ritual&mdash;[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] passed underneath this landmark during his [[Mission to rescue Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|search]] for his [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|mother]], held captive in a [[Unidentified Tusken village/Legends|Tusken village]], in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].
